title: Under the Sea
intro: [excited] Welcome in to a soaking WET episode of Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we are diving deep under the sea, so grab your snorkel, check your fins... and remember, darling, it's better down where it's wetter.

art.prompt: A vibrant coral reef kingdom deep under the ocean: shafts of sunlight, glowing anemones, bubbles, a sunken treasure chest overflowing with pearls and seashells. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Just Keep Swimming
categories.intro: We start in the Great Barrier Reef with Finding Nemo. [chuckles] If you forget the answers, just keep swimming.

art.prompt: A colorful Great Barrier Reef scene with swaying anemones and a steep drop-off into deep blue, a lone white diving mask resting on the sand. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Nemo and his dad Marlin are this orange-and-white kind of fish.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is clownfish. And no, Marlin is not funny. He will tell you that himself.

clues.clue: Marlin teams up with this forgetful blue tang to find his son.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dory, voiced by Ellen DeGeneres. [laughs] She speaks whale, she reads, and she forgets all of it in about ten seconds.

clues.clue: Dory can never forget this address written on the diver's mask.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... P. Sherman, 42 Wallaby Way, Sydney. Say it with me. If you can't, Dory can, forever.

clues.clue: The totally chill sea turtle Crush tells Marlin he is this many years old, and still young, dude.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 150. [chuckles] A hundred and fifty, dude, and still young. Rock on. Director Andrew Stanton voiced Crush himself.

clues.clue: This scarred Moorish idol leads the Tank Gang in the dentist's office and plans the big escape.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gill, voiced by Willem Dafoe. His escape plan works perfectly, if you ignore everything that went wrong.

categories.title: Something Fishy
categories.intro: Our next category is about all the fins, claws and tentacles swimming around Disney films. Something smells fishy, and it is not my lunch.

art.prompt: A sea floor gathering of shells, a golden trident stuck in the sand, crab claw shapes in silhouette, schools of colorful generic tropical fish. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Ariel's nervous yellow-and-blue best friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flounder. Fun fact, he is not actually a flounder. He looks a lot more like a tropical fish. [whispers] Don't tell him.

clues.clue: Sebastian the crab serves as court composer to this ruler of Atlantica.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is King Triton. [laughs] Seven daughters, one trident and zero tolerance for humans.

clues.clue: This giant glittery crab from Moana sings about being Shiny.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Tamatoa, voiced by Jemaine Clement. He is a coconut crab who really needs to work on his collecting habit.

clues.clue: These two slithery eels work for Ursula and spy on Ariel.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flotsam and Jetsam. [chuckles] Their names come from sailor slang for floating shipwreck junk. Fitting.

clues.clue: In Finding Dory, Dory's nearsighted childhood pipe pal Destiny is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a whale shark. Her buddy Bailey is the beluga with the busted echolocation. Great pair, terrible at parallel parking.

categories.title: Treasures of the Deep
categories.intro: [excited] Picture time! I will show you a picture of some treasures and a setting. No characters allowed. Name the watery Disney film it comes from.

art.prompt: A rocky underwater grotto filled with human treasures: forks, pipes, candlesticks, a ship's wheel, lit by beams of blue light. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Name the film this picture evokes.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is The Little Mermaid. That is a dinglehopper, of course. Scuttle says you comb your hair with it.

media.prompt: Underwater grotto lit by shafts of blue light, a silver dinner fork resting among seashells and pearls on a rock shelf, shelves of sunken human trinkets in the background, painterly animated film style, no characters, no text

clues.clue: Name the film this picture evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo. A swaying sea anemone and a lost diver's mask on the sand. [laughs] Somewhere a dad is panicking.

media.prompt: Sunlit coral reef with a large purple sea anemone, a white scuba diving mask lying in the sand nearby, a dark drop-off into deep blue water beyond, vibrant animated film style, no fish characters, no text or writing

clues.clue: Name the film this picture evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Moana. That little green stone with the spiral is the heart of Te Fiti. Please return it, Maui.

clues.clue: Name the film this picture evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Luca. [chuckles] Two sea monsters building a homemade scooter. Silencio, Bruno!

media.prompt: A rickety homemade scooter cobbled together from scrap wood, old pipes and a fruit crate, parked on a sunny rocky cliff above a turquoise Italian Riviera sea, colorful fishing village in the distance, animated film style, no people, no text

clues.clue: Name the film this picture evokes.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Atlantis: The Lost Empire from 2001. Milo's journal and a glowing crystal. Michael J. Fox voiced him. Underrated film!

media.prompt: A glowing blue crystal pendant on a cord resting on an open weathered leather explorer's journal full of sketches of a sunken city, brass submarine porthole behind, deep ocean light, illustrated adventure film style, no people, no readable text

categories.title: Make a Splash
categories.intro: [mischievously] Now we head to the parks to find the best places to get your feet wet. It is called Make a Splash.

art.prompt: A sunny theme park lagoon with a giant clamshell ride vehicle, splashing water fountains and a huge aquarium window full of fish. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: On Under the Sea, Journey of the Little Mermaid at Magic Kingdom, you ride through Ariel's story in one of these.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a clamshell. You'll find the ride in New Fantasyland, tucked under Prince Eric's castle on the cliff.

clues.clue: Epcot's giant saltwater aquarium pavilion is called The Seas with Nemo and these.
accept: the seas with nemo and friends
clues.reveal: The correct answer is friends. The Seas with Nemo and Friends holds millions of gallons of water. [laughs] That is a lot of bathwater.

clues.clue: At Epcot you can chat live with this totally tubular sea turtle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Crush, in Turtle Talk with Crush. The show is improvised, so every conversation is different. Totally.

clues.clue: This private Bahamian island has been a regular stop for Disney Cruise Line since 1998.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Castaway Cay. [chuckles] Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point is the newer island destination. Both have very sandy feet.

clues.clue: At Tokyo DisneySea, King Triton's coral castle anchors this themed port.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mermaid Lagoon, with an indoor under the sea area inside Triton's Kingdom. Tokyo DisneySea is pure magic.

categories.title: Fin-ish the Lyric
categories.intro: The Club DJ members chose Finish the Lyric, ocean edition. I give you the start of a watery song, you finish the line. [chuckles] Fin-tastic.

art.prompt: A calypso band of instruments under the sea: steel drums made from shells, a conch horn, bubbles forming musical notes. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Under the sea, under the sea, darling it's better down where it's ...
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is wetter, take it from me. Sebastian with the life advice and the calypso beat.

clues.clue: I wanna be where the people are, I wanna see, wanna see 'em ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is dancing, walking around on those, what do you call 'em? Oh, feet. [laughs] Part of Your World.

clues.clue: See the line where the sky meets the sea? It ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... calls me. How Far I'll Go, written by Lin-Manuel Miranda. And no one knows how far it goes.

clues.clue: My oh my, look like the boy too shy, ain't gonna ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is kiss the girl. [chuckles] Sha la la la la la. Eric took about three whole days and still needed a lagoon full of help.

clues.clue: In Poor Unfortunate Souls, Ursula sings: and don't underestimate the importance of ...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is body language. Ha! Ursula's whole pitch is that men up there don't like a lot of blabber. Iconic, and a little rude.
